_comment: Cydia for iPhone OS 2.x (2.2.1, rootfs/overlay-2.2.1.json; docs/cydia.md, re-log 146). Cydia 1.0.3222-73 is the last 1.0.x release that does not depend on firmware >= 4.0 (1.0.3366 does) and still names iphoneos2.0 as its SDK (MinimumOSVersion 2.0). The rest is the closure of its Depends/Pre-Depends + Essential, newest versions in apt.saurik.com/debs. Every Mach-O in the set was checked against 5H11a: no LC_DYLD_INFO(_ONLY), and every non-weak import resolves in 5H11a's own libraries/frameworks or in the set (the only misses are lazy ___floatundidf/___floatundisf in a few coreutils/tar/find/sysctl paths that print 64-bit sizes as floats). No Substrate/TLSFix (2.x has neither). Debs are cached in build/cydia-2.x (never in the shared 4.x cache).

write./private/etc/hosts:
##
# Host Database
#
# localhost is used to configure the loopback interface
# when the system is booting.  Do not change this entry.
##
127.0.0.1	localhost
255.255.255.255	broadcasthost
::1             localhost 
fe80::1%lo0	localhost
# Three of Cydia's five 2011 default sources no longer exist (ModMyi,
# ZodTTD, repo666.ultrasn0w.com). Point them at the loopback address so a
# refresh fails at once instead of waiting for DNS/connect timeouts; the
# sources stay listed until the user removes them in Sources > Edit.
127.0.0.1	apt.modmyi.com
127.0.0.1	cydia.zodttd.com
127.0.0.1	repo666.ultrasn0w.com
write./var/lib/cydia/metadata.plist:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Settings</key>
	<dict>
		<key>Role</key>
		<string>User</string>
	</dict>
</dict>
</plist>

patch.why: Cydia 1.0.3222 -[Cydia applicationDidFinishLaunching:] (0x179a0..): readlink() of /Applications, /Library/Ringtones, /Library/Wallpaper, /usr/include, /usr/lib/pam, /usr/libexec, /usr/share; any real directory (-1/EINVAL) starts 'Reorganizing' (free.sh moves it to /var/stash and stops SpringBoard). On our one-volume md0 rootfs that never succeeds, so Cydia stopped SpringBoard on every launch (QEMU). Newer Cydia skips it when /.cydia_no_stash exists; this build has no such check, so each 'adds r0,#1; bne next' -> 'b next' (Thumb d100 -> e000): the result is treated as a symlink and the stash is never started.

_metadata: metadata.plist: Cydia 1.0.x asks 'Who Are You?' on first launch until Settings/Role is set (the 4.x Cydia 1.1.30 does not ask). Preset to User (Graphical Only), the role most users picked; Manage > Settings changes it.
_sources: No source list is written. Cydia 1.0.x adds no defaults itself, and with Telesphoreo listed (apt.saurik.com tangelo-3.7) its first refresh asks for an 'Essential Upgrade' to the repo's Cydia 1.1.30 (+ cydia-lproj, BigBoss icons). In QEMU that upgrade unpacked 1.1.30 and then the UI froze; a dpkg hold made the refresh fail ('pkgProblemResolver::Resolve generated breaks'), and an /etc/apt/preferences pin still offered the upgrade and then failed ('unable to locate file for the cydia package'). Users can add sources in Manage > Sources and pick 'Ignore (Temporary)' at that prompt. base and debianutils are the repo's other Essential packages, included so a source refresh does not ask for them.
